context.text: Zebulun didn’t drive out the inhabitants of Kitron, nor the inhabitants of Nahalol; but the Canaanites lived among them, and became subject to forced labor.
Asher didn’t drive out the inhabitants of Acco, nor the inhabitants of Sidon, nor of Ahlab, nor of Achzib, nor of Helbah, nor of Aphik, nor of Rehob;
but the Asherites lived among the Canaanites, the inhabitants of the land, for they didn’t drive them out.

wikipediaRead.locator: Article body lines 294–295 and 301–304; names section identifies biblical Hebrew Akkō, and history places ancient town at Tell ʿAkkō about 1.5 km east of present city.
wikipediaRead.supportingParaphraseJa: 記事の「Names」はAcreの聖書ヘブライ語名をʻAkkōと記し、「History」は古代町が現在市街地から約1.5km離れたTell ʿAkkōにあったと説明する。士師記1:31の用例自体の位置は記事が特定しない。
